Name: AutomatedHopper(beta)
Author: honeyjarrrrr
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds the ability for Hoppers to collect finished products from machines, creating a continuous loop of feeding and collecting. It is ideal for pairing with processing machines to achieve simple automation and won’t heavily break game balance. [/color]
[b][u][color=#ff0000]❗Notes:[/color][/u][/b]
This only works for machines that take a single input item, such as the Mayonnaise Machine, Seed Maker, Recycling Machine, Bone Grinder, and Deconstructor. The Hopper will insert only one item into the machine per operation.
It is incompatible with multi-input machines that require several items at once, including the Furnace, Heavy Furnace, Smoker, and Dehydrator.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install [SMAPI 4.0+](https://smapi.io/).
2. Download this mod.
3. Place the `AutomatedHopper` folder into your Stardew Valley `Mods` directory.
4. Launch the game.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Auto Collect & Feed[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Provides light automation and won’t heavily break game balance. [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Requires at least SMAPI 4.0.0 [/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Say thanks to anyone who inspired or helped you.[/color][/size]
